title: Online and in-person courses
desc: Ongoing programme of live online workshops and courses in creative coding for sound and music — Max/MSP, Pure Data, TouchDesigner and more. Check the site for the current schedule.

title: Workshops and training
desc: Bela runs workshops and events on building responsive audio instruments with its open-source platform. See the site for upcoming sessions.

title: Classes and open sessions
desc: Member-run space in East London with regular classes, tool inductions and open access to electronics benches. Hackoustic calls it home.

title: Weekly electronics meet-up
desc: Community workshop with electronics benches and a regular electronics meet-up — a friendly place to get help with a first build.

title: Accessible music-making workshops
desc: UK charity running programmes at the intersection of music, disability and technology, including accessible instrument design.

title: Music-tech workshops for young people
desc: Colchester-based social enterprise running accessible music-tech workshops across Essex and East Anglia.

title: Hackoustic nights and workshops
desc: Hackoustic Presents nights, workshops and talks for sonic hackers of every level. Follow us for upcoming dates.

title: Sheffield media lab and workshops
desc: Long-running open-access media lab in Sheffield offering free access to technology and community workshops.
